retrieval_method: Page retrieval tool against the official Gamma API endpoint. The authoring sandbox's shell has no route to gamma-api.polymarket.com (only github.com and the package registries are reachable), so the read went through the retrieval tool. Every field below is copied as the endpoint returned it; nothing is rounded, inferred or filled in.
cache_warning: READ THIS FIRST. The same URL read twice through the retrieval tool returned byte-identical, stale payloads, while a cache-busting query string on the same market returned a newer exchange-side updatedAt and different prices, liquidity and volume. Manual reads through this path can therefore be served from an HTTP cache and must be cache-busted; the exchange-side updatedAt inside the payload, not the moment of the read, is what dates an observation. The project's own refresh already adjusts observation time for HTTP cache Age, which is why pipeline observations - not manual reads - are what this site publishes as probabilities. Recorded as irregularity polymarket-cached-manual-reads-2026-10-16 in data/review-notes.json.
